values: Source of truth: Quote Factory Quote Workflow Guide, §§12.1–12.3. UI-only comparison of original and clone. Ignore layout/order and dummy-data differences; only missing fields/capabilities, failed operations, or contradictory results are bugs.
/broker/customers → wait for settled list → open a customer row
List shows customer/contact, Booked and Quoted activity/last dates, Credit and Rep; selecting a row opens that customer.
Clone list shows Customer, Primary contact, Booked/last, Quoted/last, Credit and Rep; Add, filters, login link and export controls are visible. Opening Demo Retail Inc navigates to its detail route.
Compared with original customer list. Record count, names and values are dummy/account data and excluded.
View shipment filters → enter unmatched dummy text → See customers → Reset filters
Unmatched search settles to an empty result; Reset restores the unfiltered list.
Clone settles to 0 of 5 with No matches found; Reset restores 5 of 5 and clears the query.
Search and reset interaction confirmed in clone; guide §12.1 documents original empty-search behavior.
View shipment filters → select a Rep/team option → See customers → Reset filters
A selected available Rep/team filter applies; Reset clears it.
Clone Dallas Team selection applies and shows 0 of 5, then Reset restores 5 of 5. Original had no matching Dallas Team option in this account.
Do not report differing option availability or row counts as a bug; account data differs.
Customer header sorts and toggles direction.
Original and clone Customer header both toggle sorting.
Specific row order and names excluded.
Click Primary contact, Booked, Booked last, Quoted, Quoted last, Credit and Rep headers
Each header acts as a sort control and changes the active sort/order.
Original and clone expose each as a button; click actions changed sort indicator and/or displayed row order for the tested fields.
Different datasets/orders are excluded. UI interactions compared in both apps.
/broker/customers → Add a new customer → inspect blank form → close
Customer name search and add-as-new action are available.
Clone blank dialog shows Customer name search and Add as a new customer action.
Add a new customer → enter BUCHANAN → wait for suggestions
Show a matching existing customer suggestion plus a separate add-as-new option.
Clone showed only Add BUCHANAN as a new customer. Original showed Did you mean? with BUCHANAN COMPANY, INC and separate add-as-new.
Original and clone compared; guide §12.2 documents the matching suggestion. No create submitted.
Customer name, Vendor number, Phone, Website and About are available with Done and Close.
Original and clone General editor show all five fields and Done/Close controls.
Customer detail → click + vendor number, + website, + phone and + description
Each shortcut opens the customer identity entry flow.
Clone vendor number, website and description shortcuts open General. Original vendor number, website, phone and description shortcuts open the same General editor.
Customer profile → inspect Overview, Shipments, Quotes, Addresses, Invoices, Payments; click a tab
All six sections are selectable and open the corresponding customer section.
Both apps expose the six tabs. Clone Shipments changes the selected tab and navigates to /shipments.
Pass — visible and clone navigation verified
Logo control opens a file-source/upload picker.
Original opens Filestack with My Device, Link (URL), Take Photo, Instagram, Facebook, Google Drive and Select Files. Clone + logo click leaves the page unchanged.
Original/clone UI compared. No source selected and no upload submitted.
Customer Overview → View all customer contacts → select a contact
Contact list/detail view opens and permits selecting a contact.
Original and clone open contact views with selectable contacts and contact details.
Primary indicators and record counts are sample data and excluded.
View all customer contacts → Add new contact → inspect form → Cancel
First name, Last name, Title, Phone/email/URL details, Create and Cancel are available.
Original and clone provide name, title, one Phone/email/URL detail entry, Create and Cancel. Control arrangement differs, purpose is equivalent.
No contact created; form canceled. Requiredness/type detection/persistence not tested.
Select existing contact → Edit contact → inspect → Cancel
Edit form provides first/last name, title and contact-detail fields with Update and Cancel.
Original and clone expose name, title and contact-detail edit fields plus Update and Cancel.
Select contact → inspect communication, note and management controls
Applicable mail/phone links, copy, note, edit/delete and reorder controls are available.
Original and clone show available contact actions, communication links/copy, note, edit/delete and reorder controls.
No communication sent and no contact changed/deleted/reordered.
View all customer contacts → select a contact → inspect External references
Contact detail shows External references and Add external reference.
Original contact view shows External references and + Add external reference. Clone contact detail has no such section or action.
Original and clone compared; guide §12.3 documents the entry point. No reference added.
